name: Handoff Child v1
description: Sub-workflow called by agent k2 for human handoff: creates or reuses a handoff_requests row (pauses the bot) via rpc_handoff_create_or_reuse. Typed inputs; returns {success, code, handoff, conversation_id, correlation_id, created, audit_status}.

parameters.query:
-- handoff-link-v3: resolve the channel from the conversation row itself.
-- rpc_handoff_create_or_reuse enforces conversations.channel_id = p_channel_id, so the
-- conversation's own channel is the only id that can pass the scope check. The channel_id
-- passed by the parent is kept in metadata for audit only. Empty uuids degrade to NULL so
-- the RPC returns INVALID_INPUT instead of the query failing with a cast error.
SELECT public.rpc_handoff_create_or_reuse(
  NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid,
  NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid,
  NULLIF($3::text, '')::uuid,
  $4::text,
  (SELECT c.channel_id
     FROM public.conversations c
    WHERE c.id = NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid
      AND c.clinic_id = NULLIF($1::text, '')::uuid
      AND c.patient_id = NULLIF($3::text, '')::uuid
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL),
  $5::text,
  $6::text,
  $7::text,
  NULLIF($8::text, ''),
  NULLIF($9::text, '')::uuid,
  $10::jsonb,
  $11::jsonb
) AS result;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [String($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.clinic_id || ""), String($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.conversation_id || ""), String($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.patient_id || ""), String($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.channel_type || ""), String($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.handoff_reason || ""), String($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.reason_code || ""), String($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.priority || "NORMAL"), String($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.source_message_id || ""), String($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.correlation_id || ""), JSON.stringify($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.context_snapshot || {}), JSON.stringify($("Normalize Handoff Input").item.json.metadata || {}) ] }}
